why.title: Why Exhibit at the Fair?
why.card1_desc: Directly identify and recruit top-tier graduates and highly qualified young professionals.
why.card2_desc: Gain exceptional exposure across event exhibition spaces, media channels, and digital platforms.
why.card3_desc: Fulfill your corporate social responsibility commitments by actively supporting youth career integration.
why.card4_desc: Showcase your company culture and career growth opportunities to position yourself as an employer of choice.
why.card5_desc: Connect directly with HR decision-makers and executive leaders from over 45 leading partner companies.

students.hero_title: Your next internship. Your first job. Your future network.
students.hero_subtitle: Meet companies, discover opportunities, attend keynotes and panels, participate in hands-on workshops, and take on the HIS Talent Awards challenges.
students.meet_companies_sub: Engage directly with recruiters, discover diverse career paths, and learn what top employers look for in emerging talent.
students.meet_companies_badge: 45 Target Companies • Connect directly with hiring managers on event day
students.why_1_desc: Industry professionals and experts share their insights, journeys, and vision of the corporate landscape. Engaging discussions on emerging professions, essential skills, and market evolutions.
students.why_2_desc: Interactive workshops designed to learn, experiment, and develop practical skills immediately applicable to your academic and professional path. Learn. Build. Excel.
students.why_3_desc: Meet directly with hiring managers, discover industries, and gain insights into what companies seek in young talents. A single conversation can unlock a transformative opportunity.
students.why_4_desc: Challenges and recognitions. Participate in tailored student challenges, showcase your skills, and compete for exclusive awards and surprises throughout the event.
